title: Read a query plan first
summary: EXPLAIN shows how PostgreSQL plans to run a query.
introduction: EXPLAIN shows how PostgreSQL plans to run a query. Your task: Find the scan type in the plan output.
learningObjectives: Find the scan type in the plan output.
Explain the example for read a query plan first

blocks.text: EXPLAIN shows how PostgreSQL plans to run a query. It can help you understand a table scan before guessing which index to add.
Use PostgreSQL in a new practice database through psql or a database editor. These are PostgreSQL examples, not SQLite. They do not run in this site's SQL playground. Use only sample data.

blocks.code: EXPLAIN SELECT * FROM pg_books WHERE id=1;
blocks.title: Read a query plan first

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `EXPLAIN` describes a planned query strategy. Adding ANALYZE can execute the statement, so that extra option needs care.
`SELECT` names the output values. `AS` can give a calculated result a readable column name.
`WHERE` keeps only rows that pass its condition. Check the condition with sample data before using it for a change.

blocks.text: The plan describes a possible access method for the practice table. Exact details depend on its size and statistics.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: EXPLAIN ANALYZE actually runs the query. Be careful with statements that change data when using that option.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Find the scan type in the plan output.
